description: Music video for the song Futari de Hanbunko by Mitsuko Horie, Mamoru Ichiba, Titine & Children Chorus, and the Morinoki Jidou Gasshoudan that was featured on NHK's Minna no Uta program. The song was featured as the ending for Meiken Jolie. The video features characters from the series, but it is entirely new animation.
